# AirTixHolidays

> AirTixHolidays is a premier travel agency based in Kerala, India, specializing in flight bookings between Kerala and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, global visit visas, holiday packages, and Hajj & Umrah services.

## Key Capabilities & Core Pages
- [Home](https://airtixholiday.com/): Product overview and primary landing experience. Contains information on our services, routes, and direct booking support via WhatsApp.
- Flight Bookings: Direct flights from Calicut (CCJ), Kochi (COK), Trivandrum (TRV) to Dubai (DXB), Doha (DOH), Riyadh (RUH), Kuwait (KWI), and Muscat (MCT).
- Visit Visas: Fast-tracked processing for UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, and Schengen visas.
- Holiday Packages: Custom itineraries for families and corporate groups.
- Hajj & Umrah: Comprehensive pilgrimage packages.

## Technology & Engineering Standards
- Built with Next.js 14 App Router, utilizing Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) for optimal performance.
- Strictly follows WCAG accessibility guidelines and semantic HTML5 structure.
- Engineered to be fully responsive and performant across all devices.
